description: This file defines a singleton class 'PeekabooBridgeHostCoordinator' that manages a network socket host for the PeekabooBridge service, including setup, startup, shutdown, and symlink management for legacy socket paths. It also includes a private class 'OpenClawPeekabooBridgeServices' which provides various services related to permissions, UI automation, window management, etc., used by the coordinator.

classes.name: PeekabooBridgeHostCoordinator
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for managing the PeekabooBridge host, including starting, stopping, and ensuring legacy socket symlinks.

classes.name: OpenClawPeekabooBridgeServices
classes.description: A private class providing various system and application services required by the bridge coordinator.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the bridge host asynchronously.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the host if it is running.

methods.name: startIfNeeded
methods.description: Initializes and starts the host if it is not already running.

methods.name: ensureLegacySocketSymlinks
methods.description: Ensures all legacy socket symlinks are created.

methods.name: ensureLegacySocketSymlink
methods.description: Creates or replaces a legacy socket symlink at a specified path.

methods.name: currentTeamID
methods.description: Retrieves the current code signing team ID of the running process.
